description: List all bookings on a specific date for the connected restaurant. Returns guest name, party size, table assignment, status (including PENDING_PAYMENT for abandoned carts), source (ONLINE / MANUAL / PHONE / WALK_IN), and any special requests. Use this for daily prep, briefings, or 'who's in tonight'-style questions.

date.description: The day to list bookings for, in YYYY-MM-DD format. Use 'today' or 'tomorrow' if relative — Claude should resolve those to a real date before calling.

name: list_bookings_for_date
